facts.F10: The Infant is too young to understand the concept of adoption and has no recollection of her childhood with the Mother.

claim: The Plaintiff seeks the following information from the Banks: (1) The current balance of the Accounts as of the date of the Order to be made; (2) The account opening documents for the Accounts; (3) The bank statements of the Accounts, from the date of transfer to the date of the Order to be made; and (4) Transaction details relating to onward transfers from the Accounts.
requested_remedy: The Plaintiff seeks the following information from the Banks: (1) The current balance of the Accounts as of the date of the Order to be made; (2) The account opening documents for the Accounts; (3) The bank statements of the Accounts, from the date of transfer to the date of the Order to be made; and (4) Transaction details relating to onward transfers from the Accounts.
parties: Defendant: HANG SENG BANK, LIMITED and THE HONGKONG AND SHANGHAI BANKING CORPORATION LIMITED

facts.F1: The Plaintiff was the victim of an investment scam perpetrated by a female named Wong Tingting (Wong) who befriended and persuaded him into paying US$480,000 (approximately HK$3.74 million) (the 'Stolen Monies') to the Accounts.
facts.F2: The Stolen Monies were supposedly for the purpose of trading spot gold through an account in the name of the Plaintiff at Red Sun Capital, a foreign exchange broker recommended by Wong.
facts.F3: Huge profits were allegedly made from executed trades, but the Plaintiff was not able to withdraw monies from the purported 'trading accounts', unless a hefty fee, being 10% of the profits, was paid to Red Sun.
facts.F4: The Plaintiff did investigation and discovered that Red Sun was a real company in Hong Kong but had a different website from the one with which the Plaintiff created his trading account.
facts.F5: The Plaintiff seeks information from the Banks to identify the wrongdoers and to trace and recover the stolen Monies.
facts.F6: The Plaintiff served the Originating Summons on the Banks, neither of which contested the proceedings and did not appear.
facts.F7: The wrongdoers who own and/or operate the Accounts have been unjustly enriched at the expense of the Plaintiff.
facts.F8: The Banks have information available to them which has been derived from its innocent role in the fraud as custodian of the Accounts.

facts.F1: The plaintiff and the 1st defendant had a falling out, resulting in a dispute over the shareholding of the Hong Kong Company.
facts.F2: The 1st defendant formed new companies with similar names to the Hong Kong Company, diverting its business away from the Hong Kong Company and passing off the new companies as the successors of the Hong Kong Company's business.
